definition: Reuses Modal.Formula and Modal.Holds on a one-world frame with any act predicate as valuation. Implication recursively means implication between the same interpreted propositions, free-standing and embedded. The logical theorem proves preservation of truth in that adopted interpretation, not that source truth-aptness alone entails this semantics.
note: Shared compositional logical test, applied equally to naturalism and Catholic natural law. No modal axiom or excluded middle is required; fidelity of a full moral-language semantics remains separate.
